title: dotbabel review-complete evidence payload
description: Line 2 of a review-complete comment, base64url-encoded. The conductor reads this to decide whether the review stage already finished on the current head, so it can resume at a later phase instead of re-dispatching the review fleet.

head_sha.description: The commit the review stage finished on. Must equal the SHA in the marker on line 1; the reader refuses a payload that disagrees with its own marker.

reviewed_sha.description: The commit the post-pr-review receipt was posted against. An ancestor of head_sha, or head_sha itself: fixes pushed after the review land between the two.

posted.description: Threads whose first comment carries a post-pr-review finding marker.

unresolved.description: Always 0: the producer refuses to post while a finding thread is open.

other_open_threads.description: Open threads that are not post-pr-review findings (advisory test-quality threads, human questions). Recorded, never blocking: the review skill leaves the advisory ones open for a person on purpose.
